allowed_ips.description: List of allowed IP addresses or CIDR ranges for admin access. Empty list means allow all (not recommended).

config_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing module-specific configuration files.

default_lang.description: Default language for the web interface (ISO 639-1 two-letter code).

enabled_modules.description: List of LAM modules to enable. Common modules: users, groups, hosts, nfs, smb, sudo, ssh, printers, mail.

https_required.description: Enforce HTTPS access to the admin interface. Disable only for local development.

ldap_base.description: The base distinguished name (DN) for LDAP searches.

ldap_binddn.description: DN of the account used to bind to the LDAP directory for read/write operations.

ldap_bindpw.description: Password for the bind DN. Recommended to use a service account with minimal required privileges.

ldap_cacertfile.description: Absolute path to the CA certificate file to verify LDAPS/TLS server certificates. Leave empty to skip verification (not recommended).

ldap_host.description: LDAP server hostname or IP address. Optionally include port (e.g., 'ldap.example.com:389').

ldap_port.description: LDAP server port. Only used if port is not embedded in ldap_host. 389 for LDAP, 636 for LDAPS.

ldap_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for LDAP operations (connection and search).

ldap_usetls.description: Enable TLS (via STARTTLS) for unencrypted LDAP connections.

ldap_version.description: LDAP protocol version. Must be 3 for modern servers.

lockout_duration.description: Lockout duration in seconds after exceeding max_login_attempts.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file. If empty, logs go to syslog (recommended in containerized environments).

max_login_attempts.description: Maximum number of consecutive failed login attempts before account lockout.

modules_config.description: Array of module-specific configurations. Each element defines a module name and its config options.

password_policy_enabled.description: Enable enforcement of password complexity rules for new/changed passwords.

require_digit.description: Require at least one digit in passwords.

require_lowercase.description: Require at least one lowercase letter in passwords.

require_special.description: Require at least one special character in passwords.

require_uppercase.description: Require at least one uppercase letter in passwords.

session_lifetime.description: Session lifetime in seconds before requiring re-authentication.

session_secure.description: Set session cookie as 'Secure' (only sent over HTTPS). Required for production.

supported_languages.description: List of languages supported by the web interface (comma-separated ISO 639-1 codes).
